subject: english
stem: A community speaker gives this announcement. What is the message mainly meant to do?
options: invite visitors to make kits at the school office
explain the activity-kit rule at the school office
list only the parts in an activity kit from the school office
explain only the late-kit rule at the school office

optionRationales.reason: invite visitors to make kits at the school office：此項把「explain the activity-kit rule」改成「invite visitors to make kits」。整段資訊的目的為「explain the activity-kit rule at the school office」。因此，鎖定證據支持「explain the activity-kit rule at the school office」。
explain the activity-kit rule at the school office：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。整段資訊的目的為「explain the activity-kit rule at the school office」。

list only the parts in an activity kit from the school office：此項把「explain the activity-kit rule at」改成「list only the parts in an activity kit from」。整段資訊的目的為「explain the activity-kit rule at the school office」。因此，鎖定證據支持「explain the activity-kit rule at the school office」。

explain only the late-kit rule at the school office：此項把「the activity-kit」改成「only the late-kit」。整段資訊的目的為「explain the activity-kit rule at the school office」。因此，鎖定證據支持「explain the activity-kit rule at the school office」。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：逐句比對鎖定逐字稿，答案為「explain the activity-kit rule at the school office」。
獨立覆核 B：重新依時間順序核對說話者、細節與行動，只有「explain the activity-kit rule at the school office」成立。
